gen-tourney-gf-chivo: Wide, stretched and stout, Tourney draws every stroke at a single width, while Chivo packs its lowercase up tall with daylight in each curve. Sans-serif against display.
gen-tourney-gf-chocolate-classical-sans: Athletic from the first glance, Tourney spaces out its bulky small letters with diagonals as hefty as its stems. And Chocolate Classical Sans keeps a broad-nibbed stroke that never curls shut, so a full page of it reads easily.
gen-tourney-gf-comme: Comme reads smooth and unclogged, its lowercase bodies filling most of the letter height with no tight curves. Comme keeps a long passage moving easily, while Tourney's marker-tip letters stay up top.
gen-tourney-gf-cossette-texte: Cossette Texte reads clean and unfussy, with wide-eyed lowercase e shapes and a prominent x-height that carries the line. Tourney's stretched, bulky letters sit above it with ease.
gen-tourney-gf-duru-sans: Duru Sans reads modern and open, its small letters wide-mouthed and its bodies crowding the line while ascenders barely register. Duru Sans would carry a long passage smoothly, never snagging the eye.
gen-tourney-gf-fresca: Every stroke in Tourney is cut to one width, then stretched out by wide tracking into something bold and athletic. Fresca takes it from there, and its big bowls and short ascenders hold up at a modest size.
gen-tourney-gf-funnel-sans: Tourney stretches bulky small letters out with wide tracking. Funnel Sans keeps its stroke widths steady from stem to curve, so extended reading feels smooth, with its e opened wide and ascenders tucked just above the x-height.
gen-tourney-gf-gafata: Gafata reads tall and brisk, a band of lowercase with short stalks above and wide-eyed e shapes. Gafata would keep a long passage moving, while Tourney's bold and light strokes never mix within a word.
gen-tourney-gf-geist: Geist keeps a quiet, level beat, with words that read as solid blocks. Its opening is as wide as a sprung paper clip, so a slightly larger body size would suit it well against Tourney's stretched heading.
gen-tourney-gf-georama: Stretched, stout and sporty, Tourney bends its strokes like paperclip wire, while Georama opens its c like a bracelet pulled apart. Side by side they feel energetic up top and friendly below.
